post.description: Available through account_router or the explicit EMILYBASE_ACCOUNT_ROOT executable mode; legacy registry mode has no private routes. Not anonymous signup. Bearer ProjectKey is a private service key, never a public frontend credential. User tokens grant no SQL authority. Strict4096-byte JSON/five-second body bound; no client time.30 private attempts per project/minute plus120 per peer IP/minute. See docs/private-http.md.

post.summary: Remove a bounded number of inactive session families with current service authority
post.description: Explicit private-root operation under the current project service key. Strict JSON limit integer1..128; no client time or automatic scheduling. Revoked, expired refresh, stale account-epoch and old-incarnation families are eligible; access expiry alone preserves a refreshable family. Return only the removed count after durable commit. Zero removals may still durably advance trusted server time. A backward clock refuses. Shared private body/worker/rate/no-cache rules apply; user/master/cross-project credentials do not substitute. No storage compaction, byte-reclamation promise or public user authority.

200.description: Durable bounded removal; separate clock observation may commit even when removed is zero

post.description: Current project service key required before body work and again at execution. Strict JSON limit1..128 and optional after canonical ASCII login/null; absent logins are valid exclusive boundaries. Unknown/duplicate fields and client time refuse. Explicit metadata only, no password/verifier/session/family exports. Read-only operation does not advance trusted time or WAL. Each request reads current state; continuation does not pin a cross-request snapshot. Shared private body/worker/rate/no-cache/static-error rules apply; master/user/cross-project credentials do not substitute.

post.summary: Read one row by exact typed primary key
post.description: Project service authority only in both data modes. Strict65,536-byte body and response caps,5-second body deadline,four shared admitted workers. Integer values use canonical decimal strings; finite floats use16 lowercase hexadecimal bit digits. No SQL interpolation or private-clock/WAL change. Success/refusal disable caches. Page output refuses as a whole above the byte cap; lower limit and retry. Missing point is row:null. Update/delete missing and duplicate insert refuse. Replies to writes follow original durable commit; no idempotency key.

200.description: Complete bounded result; mutation transaction is acknowledged

post.summary: Trusted backend policy-enforced user get
post.description: Retained account-root mode only. Current project service Bearer key AND exactly one X-EmilyBase-Access header with current user access token are required. Service keys belong only in trusted backend code. Rechecks current key/private roster after five-second body wait before decode; derives actual held table ID/schema and verifies current session/policy/time under both original owners. Same strict lossless row grammar, 65536-byte complete request/response limits, four shared workers and private 30-attempt/minute project limit. Get masks missing and SELECT-denied rows as row:null. Page returns only SELECT-permitted rows and visible continuation keys, observing current state separately per call. Write accepts 1..256 typed operations in one original atomic commit with staged USING/CHECK; any denial discards all changes. Forward private time observation is a separate commit. No SQL, DDL, automatic retry, idempotency receipt, user-only/browser authority or legacy route. Lost/uncertain writes require inspection.

200.description: Complete bounded result; mutation transaction is acknowledged

400.description: Invalid strict request, typed key/row or actual table: user_row_rejected or table_rejected.

503.description: Response/storage uncertainty: user_row_outcome_requires_inspection; current binding/catalog/clock/worker failures also refuse with static codes. Never infer rollback.

403.description: Policy or typed packet refused: user_row_rejected. No partial public commit.

409.description: Private v4 policy catalog has not been explicitly enabled: policy_catalog_disabled.
